name: Rows
description: A collection of Row objects that represent the table rows in the specified selection, range, or table.
remarks: Use the Rows property to return the Rows collection. The following example centers rows in the first table in the active document between the left and right margins. Use the Add method to add a row to a table. The following example inserts a row before the first row in the selection. Use Rows (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single Row object. The index number represents the position of the row in the selection, range, or table. The following example deletes the first row in the first table in the active document.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of rows in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: AllowBreakAcrossPages
properties.description: True if the text in a table row or rows are allowed to split across a page break. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdRowAlignment constant that represents the alignment for the specified rows. Read/write.

properties.name: HeadingFormat
properties.description: True if the specified row or rows are formatted as a table heading. Read/write Long.

properties.name: SpaceBetweenColumns
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between text in adjacent columns of the specified row or rows. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of the specified rows in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: HeightRule
properties.description: Returns or sets the rule for determining the height of the specified cells or rows. Read/write WdRowHeightRule.

properties.name: LeftIndent
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the left indent value (in points) for the specified table rows. Read/write.

properties.name: First
properties.description: Returns a Row object that represents the first item in the Rows collection.

properties.name: Last
properties.description: Returns the last item in the Rows collection as a Row object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Rows object.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns a Borders collection that represents all the borders for the specified object.

properties.name: Shading
properties.description: Returns a Shading object that refers to the shading formatting for the specified object.

properties.name: WrapAroundText
properties.description: Returns or sets whether text should wrap around the specified rows. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DistanceTop
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the document text and the top edge of the specified table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: DistanceBottom
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the document text and the bottom edge of the specified table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: DistanceLeft
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the document text and the left edge of the specified table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: DistanceRight
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the document text and the right edge of the specified table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: HorizontalPosition
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal distance between the edge of the rows and the item specified by the RelativeHorizontalPosition property. Read/write Single.

properties.name: VerticalPosition
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical distance between the edge of the rows and the item specified by the RelativeVerticalPosition property. Read/write Single.

properties.name: RelativeHorizontalPosition
properties.description: Specifies the relative horizontal position of a group of rows. Read/write WdRelativeHorizontalPosition.

properties.name: RelativeVerticalPosition
properties.description: Specifies the relative vertical position of a group of rows. Read/write WdRelativeVerticalPosition.

properties.name: AllowOverlap
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that specifies whether the specified rows can overlap other rows.

properties.name: NestingLevel
properties.description: Returns the nesting level of the specified table rows. Read-only Long.

properties.name: TableDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the direction in which Microsoft Word orders cells in the specified table or row. Read/write WdTableDirection.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual Row object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Returns a Row object that represents a row added to a table.

parameters.name: BeforeRow
parameters.description: A Row object that represents the row that will appear immediately below the new row.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects a collection of rows in a table.

methods.name: SetLeftIndent
methods.signature: SetLeftIndent(LeftIndent As Single, RulerStyle As WdRulerStyle)
methods.description: Sets the indentation for a row or rows in a table.

parameters.name: LeftIndent
parameters.description: The distance (in points) between the current left edge of the specified row or rows and the desired left edge.

parameters.name: RulerStyle
parameters.description: Controls the way Microsoft Word adjusts the table when the left indent is changed. The WdRulerStyle behavior applies to left-aligned tables. The WdRulerStyle behavior for center- and right-aligned tables can be unexpected; in these cases, use the SetLeftIndent method with care.

methods.name: SetHeight
methods.signature: SetHeight(RowHeight As Single, HeightRule As WdRowHeightRule)
methods.description: Sets the height of table rows.

parameters.name: RowHeight
parameters.description: The height of the row or rows, in points.

parameters.name: HeightRule
parameters.description: The rule for determining the height of the specified rows.

methods.name: DistributeHeight
methods.description: Adjusts the height of the specified rows or cells so that they're equal.

methods.name: ConvertToText
methods.signature: ConvertToText([Separator As Variant], [NestedTables As Variant]) As Range
methods.description: Converts rows in a table to text and returns a Range object that represents the delimited text.

parameters.name: Separator
parameters.description: The character that delimits the converted columns (paragraph marks delimit the converted rows). Can be any following WdTableFieldSeparator constants: wdSeparateByCommas, wdSeparateByDefaultListSeparator, wdSeparateByParagraphs, or wdSeparateByTabs (Default).

parameters.name: NestedTables
parameters.description: True if nested tables are converted to text. This argument is ignored if Separator is not wdSeparateByParagraphs. The default value is True.
